metadata.statistical_discipline: Five frozen E checkpoints are the independent units; F is a control. Probes are analysis-only, fit on a regime's train, tuned on its val, evaluated once on the untouched test hard tail. Every predeclared stage is reported; no test-based activation selection.

primary_decision.rule_note: S-MIX if subtype spread >= 0.15 at >=2 stages or E/F disagree; S-A if an internal chain stage beats C_t by >=0.10 (>=4/5 seeds) with held-out accuracy >=0.30 and seen-heldout gap <0.20; S-B if the D1x chain scalar is non-increasing with max drop >=0.10 and earliest stage >=0.30; S-C if no internal gain <0.10 and held-out <=0.25. Bars are declared conventions; continuous effect sizes are reported alongside.
